facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

facts.value: To deepen analytical and quantitative competencies.
QTEM Track 1: 1 semester abroad + an internship of 240 hours; QTEM Track 2: 2 semesters abroad + an internship of 240 hours.
Participants engage in the QTEM Global Business Analytics Challenge (GBAC, 8 ECTS).
A total of 50 ECTS points in quantitative courses must be earned, including 22 ECTS for each semester abroad at a QTEM partner university.
The master's thesis is written at the home university in Frankfurt.
Students receive the master's degree from the Department as well as a QTEM certificate upon successful completion.
A GMAT score of at least 555 points is required or an equivalent GRE score.
Starting from the fourth quarter of 2024, a new GMAT test format will be introduced. The previous format will still be accepted with a minimum score of 600.
Students in the first semester of master's programs in Business Administration, Management Science, Money, Macro and Finance, as well as International Economics and Economic Policy can apply.
The application deadline for the academic year 2026/27 is February 1, 2026.
New announcements are published in late October, with an application deadline of February 1 of the following year.
EDHEC Business School, Lille, France; Université Paris Dauphine, France; LUISS, Rome, Italy; Politecnico di Milano, Italy; DCC Business School, Dublin, UK; Exeter Business School, UK.
